steps.title: Web service - Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Set your authentik host name. For a name that is not public, switch Automatic Let's Encrypt off, save, open the service again, switch it off again and save.

steps.title: Web service - Upstream and WebSockets
steps.subtitle: Update both upstream hosts together. The WebSocket field of the /ws/ entry is a text box: keep yes.

steps.title: HTTP - API, uploads and browser compatibility
steps.subtitle: Review API methods, upload size, request rate, cookies and CSP.

steps.title: Security - Review CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Allow Python, CSS and HTML only in the documented admin fields.
